name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 136 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Tel Aviv.
status.nb: 136 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Tel Aviv.

summary.en: Israeli military forces detained US Democratic politician Brad Lander and other volunteers during a West Bank olive harvest while settlers attacked Palestinian farmers and olive trees, injuring civilians. UNICEF reported that 340 children have been killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire. An Israeli minister called for settling the entire West Bank, and a far-right rival was offered a Gaza expulsion portfolio if he quits the election. Reuters noted Lander was released after detention. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels militære styrker arresterte den amerikanske demokratiske politikeren Brad Lander og andre frivillige under en oliveninnhøsting på Vestbredden mens bosettere angrep palestinske bønder og oliventrær, og såret sivile. UNICEF rapporterte at 340 barn er drept i Gaza til tross for en våpenhvile. En israelsk minister oppfordret til å bosette hele Vestbredden, og en høyreorientert rival ble tilbudt et portefølje for utvisning fra Gaza dersom han trekker seg fra valget. Reuters bemerket at Lander ble løslatt etter varetektsfengslingen. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
